name: Village de Poul-Fetan

dates.altered: Acquired by the commune of Quistinic in 1977; restoration of the buildings began in 1979 and the village opened to the public in 1985, per the operator's own account.
dates.note: NO SOURCE READ HERE DATES THE BUILDINGS. The operator's own site says only that the restored hamlet presents Breton peasant life « en 1850 » and gives the acquisition, restoration and opening dates above. The node's exemplar note calls the longères « 16th-19th century », and nothing found supports the 16th-century end of that span; it is recorded as unresolved rather than repeated.

refs.title: Un village, une renaissance | Poul-Fetan
refs.note: Read as continuous prose. It says « Poul Fetan fut acquis par la commune de Quistinic en 1977 », « La restauration des bâtiments commença en 1979 et dès 1985 le village ouvre au public », and that « Le bâti exceptionnel du hameau, au premier rang desquelles les superbes chaumières, ont été restaurées à l'aide des matériaux et techniques originelles. »

refs.title: Parc Village de Poul-Fetan – Présentation 2024 | Poul-Fetan
refs.note: « C'est un village de chaumières entièrement restauré, retraçant la vie quotidienne des paysans au XIX siècle. » The operator presents the site as an 1850 tableau, not as a dated building group.

refs.title: Quistinic. Hameau abandonné il y a 50 ans, la résurrection de Poul-Fetan depuis 1977
refs.note: Corroborates the abandonment and the 1977 start of the recovery from a second surface.

note: Tranche 3, French manoir and provincial farmhouse cluster, 5 Sep 2026. `record_kind: group` -- a named, documented set of buildings under one operator, which is what the node means by « preserved as a working ensemble ». No Base Mérimée notice was found for the hamlet or for any building in it, so there is no `survey` and no measurement. THE RECORD'S SHARPEST FINDING IS A NEGATIVE ONE: this is a hamlet restored to depict 1850, and the operator's own literature never dates its fabric; a reader who took the node's « 16th-19th century granite longeres » from the exemplar note would be repeating a claim the site itself does not make.
